dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin with an approximate 45-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened rostrum with a pixel length roughly equal to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the transition point between the melon's descent and the rostrum's dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial monochromatic green rendering style with high-contrast luminance highlighting along the dorsal and mid-lateral surfaces.
